Deadlines
The Winter 2027 and Spring 2027 application is open to new applicants for select programs only.
The Summer/Fall 2027 application opens on September 1, 2026 to new applicants, for most graduate programs, on a rolling basis.
×
UC Riverside operates in a quarter system. Each quarter typically begins:
Summer: mid-June
Fall: late September
Winter: early January
Spring: late March/early April
Most programs only admit and begin in the Fall quarter. We encourage you to visit our Graduate Programs page for more information.
New Applicants and Reapplicants
If you are applying for the first time or reapplying due to not being admitted, admitted but unable to attend, or admitted and unable to complete your entire first quarter, you will need to complete our standard application.
Domestic (U.S. Citizen and U.S. Permanent Resident)
Summer - May 1st
Fall - January 5th (Fellowship Consideration*) / June 1st (Admission Only)**
Winter - November 1st
Spring - February 1st
International (Non-Immigrant/Visa Students)
Summer - March 1st
Fall - January 5th (Fellowship Consideration) / June 1st (Admission Only)
Winter - September 1st
Spring - December 1st
*Fellowship Consideration: Applications received after January 5th will be considered for financial support based on funding availability and if the degree objective selected is eligible for fellowship funding. Please consult with the graduate program prior to applying. Some programs may have earlier priority/fellowship consideration deadlines, and earlier deadline dates than our standard posted deadlines, above. Consult your program directly to confirm.
**A few programs have an application deadline after June 1. Consult with the individual graduate program for clarification.
Returning and Continuing Students
If you have registered and completed one quarter of attendance at UCR (whether you completed a graduate program or not), the below deadlines will apply to you. If you are not certain if you are meeting the requirements of a returning or continuing student, please visit our Returning & Continuing Students page.
All Students
Summer - May 1st
Fall - August 1st
Winter - November 1st
Spring - February 1st
